note: flags from an independent visual reviewer who looked at the compare images

flags.problem: Glyph W keeps its shape but strokes get a soft grey halo and airbrushed glow; feet blow out to white blobs; 1:1 looks mushy.
flags.fix: Cut the luminance sharpen radius or halo; keep stroke edges hard-ish; stop feet clipping to white. Keep the original pixel-stroke rhythm.

flags.problem: Original flower-like stamped band with crisp alpha edge becomes a diffuse purple cloud at 1:1; stamp shapes are lost and edges feather.
flags.fix: Keep the stamp structure from the original (upscale stamps, not generic noise) and tighten the alpha edge; reduce uniform paint grain.

flags.problem: Silhouette edge has a speckled light-grey fringe and noisy bumps around the plate; 1:1 rivets look oversized vs the original.
flags.fix: Clean the alpha edge (remove injected speckle at the boundary) and scale the library plate detail down so rivets match the original scale.

flags.problem: no real detail gain over a smooth enlargement (0.97x)
flags.fix: make it pass the gate honestly, or mark(...) it if it cannot
